entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A black body at the 2,750 K dayside brightness temperature measured in secondary eclipse in the Kepler, Ks, 3.6 µm and 4.5 µm bands together (Shporer et al. 2014, the temperature of a black body showing the same occultation depths in all four bands): #ffae5c. Read from the paper (abstract): the paper's own value; Esteves et al. 2015's Kepler-band 3,490 K assumes no reflected light and is not used. Reflected starlight is not included.
